# Final Review Votes
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.5-xhigh

## Summary

Both amendments are technically justified and reduce concrete repository/documentation defects.

## Votes

- `fr-3-5382e896`: Accept
  A tracked Nix result symlink is a reproducibility and maintenance defect: its store path changes across builds and will cause persistent phantom diffs. Removing it from the index and ignoring future result outputs is safe and matches normal Nix project hygiene.
- `fr-3-5470ceac`: Accept
  The current documentation materially misdescribes the serialized VSS share format, including encoding, required blinder fields, 24-word high-half fields, mnemonic_length, public-only wallet metadata, and duress behavior. Updating it to match VssJsonWalletDescriptionV0 improves safety and maintainability; the rewrite should be checked against the actual struct so all serialized SinglesigPublicMetadataV0 fields are represented.
